failed_questions.reference_sql: WITH weekly_chain AS (  SELECT week_start_date, AVG(avg_oil_price) AS oil_price,   SUM(total_sales) AS chain_weekly_sales   FROM weekly_store_family_summary   WHERE avg_oil_price IS NOT NULL   GROUP BY week_start_date) SELECT CASE WHEN oil_price < 50 THEN 'UNDER_50' ELSE 'AT_OR_ABOVE_50' END AS oil_regime, COUNT(*) AS n_weeks, ROUND(AVG(chain_weekly_sales), 2) AS avg_weekly_sales FROM weekly_chain GROUP BY oil_regime ORDER BY oil_regime ASC
